# picolibc cross file for Astra 68.
#
# The stock scripts/cross-m68k-linux-gnu.txt targets -march=68020 with the
# toolchain's default float ABI. Astra builds -m68030 -msoft-float, and a libc
# built for a different float ABI links without complaint and returns wrong
# answers, so this file exists rather than a flag on the command line.

[binaries]
c = ['m68k-linux-gnu-gcc', '-m68030', '-msoft-float', '-static', '-nostdlib', '-Wl,--build-id=none']
ar = 'm68k-linux-gnu-ar'
as = 'm68k-linux-gnu-as'
ld = 'm68k-linux-gnu-ld'
nm = 'm68k-linux-gnu-nm'
strip = 'm68k-linux-gnu-strip'

[host_machine]
system = 'unknown'
cpu_family = 'm68k'
cpu = '68030'
endian = 'big'

[properties]
link_spec = '--build-id=none'
skip_sanity_check = true
default_flash_addr = '0x00000000'
default_flash_size = '0x00400000'
default_ram_addr   = '0x00400000'
default_ram_size   = '0x00400000'
